# Guitar sample credits

These MP3 samples are excerpts from **FluidR3_GM**, distributed by the
[MIDI.js Soundfonts project](https://github.com/gleitz/midi-js-soundfonts),
which identifies FluidR3_GM as licensed under
[Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 US](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/us/).

Source banks:

- [distortion_guitar-mp3.js](https://github.com/gleitz/midi-js-soundfonts/blob/gh-pages/FluidR3_GM/distortion_guitar-mp3.js)
- [acoustic_guitar_steel-mp3.js](https://github.com/gleitz/midi-js-soundfonts/blob/gh-pages/FluidR3_GM/acoustic_guitar_steel-mp3.js)

For Ritim İzi, 17 samples per instrument (MIDI 40 through 88, every third
semitone) were extracted from the original base64 bank into individual MP3 files.
The MP3 data is unchanged. Other pitches, envelopes, muting, and techniques are
applied during playback. These are instrument samples from a soundfont, not
recordings of the user's guitar. No endorsement by the source project is implied.
